QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] The Start of Change
QuestInfo.0: During the Shrelephant hunt, Shulla got cornered by a Raging Werebeast that seemed to appear out of nowhere.
QuestInfo.1: During the Shrelephant hunt, Shulla got cornered by a Raging Werebeast that seemed to appear out of nowhere.
QuestInfo.2: Kan was the only one quick enough to save Shulla, but he said some harsh words in the process and hurt her feelings. All of the excitement seemed to be too much for Kan. It took Peytour and the other villagers ages to calm him down, and he finally apologized for his behavior.
